free_tier.stated: none reachable: 2 GiB free per org, hard block on publish at the cap, and pay-go tiers start at $2/GB for the 2-10 GiB band. The 4 TiB Universal Package file ceiling is unusable with 2 GiB of pool.

per_object_cap.stated: Universal Packages have a 4 TiB per-file limit; NuGet, npm, Maven, Python and Cargo have 500 MiB per-file limits, and npm package.json has a 375 KB hard limit.

retention.stated: Retention policies can automatically delete older package versions and manage storage consumption.

interface_detail: Package clients such as nuget.exe are used with Azure Artifacts; feeds hold NuGet, npm, Maven, Python, Cargo and Universal Packages.
chaining: Feeds support 20 upstreams per package type per feed, so packages are pulled from upstream sources into the feed.
